surface_mechanism_description: Exchange reaction between In2S3 and DEZ, combined with diffusion of species within the film.
evidence: The exchange reaction between the In2S3 layer and DEZ is described by the following equation [Eq. (6)]: In2S3 + 3Zn(C2H5)2 -> 3ZnS + 2In(C2H5)3. This reaction results in a small mass loss which explains the lower MGPC of the ZnS layer grown on In2S3. The authors also mention that the atomic compositions of the ZnInxSy films can be explained by a rate-limited exchange reaction at the surface between DEZ and the In2S3 layer, combined with diffusion of the species in the whole film.
